name: offline
description: App sin conexión de Virtual Book (Tauri 2): envuelve la web compilada.

scripts.web: VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.virtualbook.local vite build && mkdir -p dist-web/paquetes && python3 -I ../../content/material/_qa_tools/exportar_manifiesto.py dist-web/paquetes/muestra.json antropologia
scripts.android:apk: scripts/preparar-android.sh && pnpm run web && tauri android build --apk --target aarch64 armv7
scripts.android:apk-prueba: scripts/preparar-android.sh && pnpm run web && tauri android build --debug --apk --target x86_64
